forecast_handoff.accounting_basis: FY2027 uses company tariff-refund-excluded adjusted EPS guidance; FY2028-FY2029 are explicitly labelled management-guidance-anchored model scenarios. All forecast EPS excludes the FY2027 Q2 tariff-refund benefit; FY2026 TTM also excludes the FY2026 Q4 non-recurring interchange-fee settlement for comparability.

scenario_assumptions.FY2027_base_fact: Company guided to adjusted (tariff-refund-excluded) diluted EPS of $5.15-$5.20; $5.175 is the midpoint.
scenario_assumptions.FY2028_FY2029_base_model: 4% store growth, low-single-digit comparable sales and continued buybacks produce EPS of $5.53 and $5.87. This is a model assumption, not company guidance.
scenario_assumptions.bear_model: Near-flat FY2027-FY2028 EPS at $4.55 from weaker consumer demand and merchandise-margin pressure, followed by modest FY2029 recovery to $4.83. This is a model assumption.
scenario_assumptions.capital_path: Share counts of 1,103m, 1,085m and 1,068m reflect the announced FY2027 buyback program followed by slower repurchases; it is a model assumption.

valuation_handoff.roe_reliability: usable_with_caution: high ROA is the primary return driver; buybacks compress equity but the current equity multiplier 3.59 is below the three-year median 3.92, so no incremental multiplier cap is applied.
valuation_handoff.pr_roe_role: standardized PE_TTM / standardized ROE_TTM, dynamically adjusted only for the three-year ordinary-dividend payout ratio; ROA is a reliability check and is not substituted into the PR formula.

core_roe_correction.interpretation: $419m settlement was converted using the same-quarter actual effective tax rate: (FY2026 tax expense $1,805m - first-nine-month tax expense $1,188m) / (FY2026 pre-tax income $7,299m - first-nine-month pre-tax income $4,909m). The tariff benefit uses the company-disclosed $0.14 EPS effect.

valuation_handoff.roe_average_equity_method: two-point TTM average equity: (August 2, 2025 equity $8,866m + August 1, 2026 equity $10,651m) / 2 = $9,758.5m

dividend_payout_adjustment.note: This is ordinary cash-dividend payout only. Share repurchases are handled through share-count and ROE reliability checks, and are not used to inflate N.

scenario_weights.reason: The $0.164 PR gap is material for retail, while tariff and consumer-margin uncertainty persists; bear weight is increased from the neutral-quality default.

normalization.method: neutral: 60% three-year standardized history plus 20%/12%/8% FY2027/FY2028/FY2029 base; bear: weak historical core year plus bear forecast path.

dupont_ttm.roe_driver: high normalized operating margin and asset turnover; equity buybacks remain material but current leverage multiplier is not above its recent normal range.

roa_adjustment.reason: The asset denominator is period-aligned; correction is required solely because two identified non-recurring profit items otherwise inflate the TTM numerator.

price_bands.basis: FY2027 standardized EPS; each USD band is the 45% neutral / 55% bear weighted price unless a bear-PR hard condition requires the more conservative upper bound.

samples.nonrecurring_check: No hit for credit-card interchange, settlement agreement, non-recurring gain or litigation settlement in the point-in-time 10-Q text.
No hit for the same adjustment keywords in the point-in-time 10-Q text.

samples.status: provisional; realized drawdown exceeds 20%, but the 12-month observation window closes 2027-06.

company_pr_history.confidence: medium; the current-cycle peak remains provisional

exit_anchors.formula: H=min(mean PR, median PR, 1.00); S=0.85*H; M=(H+1.00)/2

broken_case.meaning: Risk-budget boundary rather than a stop-loss or a forecast price target.

fundamental_exit_triggers: Two consecutive quarters of comparable-sales and merchandise-margin deterioration versus management plan
Operating cash flow after capital expenditure fails to cover ordinary dividends over a rolling year without a disclosed temporary working-capital reason
Inventory growth materially outpaces sales with recurring markdown pressure
A material deterioration in TJX buying advantage, value proposition or capital-return discipline

peer_timing.reason: KSS stopped making new lows after August 26. BURL was still making new lows through August 31 and its five-trading-day stability test is not met; OLLI made a new low on September 3. ROST has stabilized after September 1 but is a leader peer, not counted in the weak denominator. Thus only 1 of 3 valid weak peers meets the five-trading-day test, below the required ceil(3*40%)=2. This timing layer does not alter value or target size.
